title: Geometry and classifications of some $ω$-Lie algebras
summary: Using group actions and orbit-stabilizer methods, we study the geometry of isomorphism classes of finite-dimensional $ω$-Lie algebras over a field $\mathbb{K}$ of characteristic $\neq 2$ and establish a one-to-one correspondence between the set of isomorphism classes and the orbit space of a stabilizer of $ω$. We also apply techniques from computational ideal theory to explore the geometric structure of the affine variety of all 3-dimensional $ω$-Lie algebras over $\mathbb{K}$, showing that this variety is a 6-dimensional irreducible affine variety and a complete intersection.
